computes: a carry: (t mod 256, t div 256) of a run word, by I32Rem and I32Div
rule: integer floors and mods are budgeted, one unit an output

computes: a carry from comparisons: t mod 256 and t div 256 for t < 4096, by 4 rounds of U32Ge and two SelectI32
rule: compares and selects are budgeted, one unit an output

computes: [r < 1000] for r < 2^18 from two .satfinite IMMA steps whose incoming accumulator is r + S32_MAX - 2^18
rule: a bare IMMA outside the s8 family is refused; a runtime T_0 with no derived interval makes the clamp a comparison

computes: a word whose s32 sign is [r >= 1000], from one u8 x s8 IMMA step without .satfinite at T_0 = r + 2^31 - 2^18
rule: a bare IMMA outside the s8 family is refused; a runtime T_0 with no derived interval makes the wrap a comparison

computes: a K = 132,096 chain over run s8 inputs that clamps at S32_MAX from step 4,096 on (33 steps), under a declared operand bound of +-127 the inputs exceed at -128
rule: a bare IMMA outside the s8 family is refused; operand ranges come from the producer, never from a declaration

computes: a computed s32 word's leaf read where an 8-bit E4M3 code is typed
rule: an implicit reinterpretation of a runtime word is refused; one type per committed word

computes: six bits of a run word at a run-chosen byte offset, by PouwNoiseByte over a value that is not the coin
rule: the noise derivation's inputs are the coin and statics only; else PouwNoiseByte is budgeted

computes: the receipt fold's mixer, y' = (y ^ d0 ^ k0) * a0 + d1 mod 2^32, its output added into a second output
rule: the receipt fold's output is a sink; the fold is unregistered, so its four gates are budgeted

computes: any function of a 7-bit run index, (i^2 + 7i) mod 251, by GatherF32x128
rule: gathers are budgeted by fresh runtime index bits

computes: S8Dot{K = 132,096, A = B = (-127, 127)} binds (its no_wrap holds for the declared bounds) and clamps at S32_MAX on run inputs at -128
rule: operand ranges come from the producing Definition, never declared

computes: [r < 1000] from two S8Dot{T0 = input, C = (0, 2^18)} instances whose accumulator is r + S32_MAX - 2^18
rule: T_0's interval is derived from its producer, not declared

computes: a word whose s32 sign is [r >= 1000], from S8Dot{T0 = input, C = (0, 2^18), DOT = u8 x s8} at T_0 = r + 2^31 - 2^18
rule: T_0's interval is derived from its producer, not declared

computes: two S8Dot{K = 131,040} halves over run s8 inputs, each within s32, whose I32Add combine wraps
rule: a split-K combine is inside the interval analysis; one that may wrap is not free-affine

computes: a runtime S8Dot word as three s8 limbs by LimbSplit_v1{bytes, N = 3}
rule: a LimbSplit of a runtime word is budgeted, a carry a limb beyond the first

computes: the same three limbs from S32LowByte and S32ByteCarry called outside LimbSplit_v1
rule: every registered primitive outside the free set is budgeted, one unit an output

computes: LimbSplit_v1{bytes, N = 2, Y = (-32640, 32639)} on a word in [-520192, 524288]: its last limb truncates a second carry
rule: a split's Y is its producer's interval, not declared

computes: a runtime S8Dot word read back as the s8 operand codes of a second S8Dot, without a split
rule: an implicit reinterpretation (an s32 word read back as s8 limbs) is refused

computes: one int8 linear coordinate at K = 28,672 (s8 by s8, from T_0 = 0)
rule: free-family: the window is proven from the operands' type range

computes: one query against 131,072 keys at head dimension 128
rule: free-family

computes: P·V at 131,072 keys: P in [0, 127] from its producer against V in [-128, 127], 128 channels
rule: free-family only with P's interval derived from PQUANT (with P in [-128, 127] the window ends at 131,071)

computes: P·V at 131,072 keys split at 65,536, the halves added by I32Add
rule: free-family halves; the combine is free-affine, its interval within s32

computes: P·V at 132,096 keys, the most a family K holds within s32 for P in [0, 127] against V in [-128, 127]
rule: the interval rules for P's producers (F32Fmaxf, F32Fminf, F32ToU32RzByte); without them P reads as s8 and the window ends at 131,071

computes: P·V at 132,128 keys over PQUANT's P in [0, 127], bound with A = (0, 126): from runs at -128 the last step clamps at S32_MIN, one comparison a channel
rule: operand ranges come from the producer, never declared; the interval rules for P's producers (F32Fmaxf, F32Fminf, F32ToU32RzByte) prove the window to 132,104 keys only

computes: P·V at 132,096 keys with P = RzByte(fminf(p, 127)), no fmaxf: RzByte takes every negative and NaN to 0
rule: F32ToU32RzByte's rule is cvt.rzi.u32.f32's, which saturates below at 0; a rule that reads a negative input as a wrapped byte refuses this, over-strict

computes: P·V at 131,072 keys with P = RzByte(fmaxf(p, 0)), no fminf: P is the truncation's whole low byte, read as s8, so the last step clamps at S32_MAX, one comparison a channel
rule: F32ToU32RzByte's output is [0, 255] unless its input is below 256: the interval rules for P's producers (F32Fmaxf, F32Fminf, F32ToU32RzByte)

computes: P·V at 132,096 keys with P = RzByte(fminf(fmaxf(p, 0), 128)): the byte 128 is s8 -128, so the last 33 steps may clamp at S32_MAX, 33 comparisons a channel
rule: P's interval is its producer's, [0, 128], and its s8 reading [-128, 127]: the interval rules for P's producers (F32Fmaxf, F32Fminf, F32ToU32RzByte)
